usageNotes: Orders a new TLS certificate from the configured ACME CA (e.g., Let's Encrypt) for the specified node using the domain and challenge plugin already set up under Node > ACME. The operation is asynchronous — the returned string is a task UPID; poll it via GET /nodes/{node}/tasks/{upid}/status to confirm success. The node must have a valid ACME account and at least one domain configured before calling this endpoint.

examples.summary: Issue a new ACME certificate for node pve1, overwriting any existing custom cert

tips: ACME account and domain(s) must be configured first via /nodes/{node}/config (acmedomain0, acmedomain1, etc.) before ordering a certificate.
Omit 'force' (or set it to false) if you want the call to fail rather than silently overwrite a manually-installed certificate.
Let's Encrypt rate-limits certificate issuance to 5 duplicate certificates per week — use the staging directory for testing.
After a successful order, Proxmox automatically replaces the node's pveproxy certificate and reloads the service; an active browser session will need to be refreshed.
